title: Deep_Sea_Odyssey_90s
global_style: BBC Blue Planet documentary style, National Geographic underwater cinematography, IMAX 8k photorealistic, volumetric underwater lighting, extreme detail, smooth stabilized camera motion, natural marine colors
negative_prompt: low quality, worst quality, deformed, distorted, disfigured, motion smear, motion artifacts, text, subtitles, watermark, logo, cartoon, anime, CGI look, overexposed

shots.prompt: Breathtaking underwater shot looking up at golden sunbeams piercing through crystal clear turquoise ocean surface, shimmering god rays dancing through a massive swirling bait ball of silver sardines and dolphins
Smooth descending camera gliding over a vibrant coral reef canyon teeming with tropical fish, a giant oceanic manta ray gracefully banking and gliding across the sunbeams in slow motion

Following the manta ray toward the edge of a steep continental shelf drop-off where bright turquoise water transitions into deep indigo abyss, a sleek scientific deep-sea submersible descending with warm golden spotlights
The submersible descends deeper through the thermocline layer, sunlight fading into dark sapphire blue above, tiny bioluminescent plankton beginning to sparkle like stars around the viewport
Entering the pitch-black mesopelagic twilight zone, hundreds of translucent bioluminescent crystal jellyfish pulsing with ethereal cyan, magenta, and violet neon light in the dark ocean
Extreme macro close-up tracking a delicate deep-sea comb jelly ctenophore drifting in the current, iridescent rainbow light waves rippling along its cilia rows against the dark blue void
Wide cinematic panning shot in the dark midnight zone as a colossal deep-sea giant squid with glowing sapphire eyes and flowing tentacles glides silently past the submersible's light beam
The submersible's powerful volumetric spotlight cuts through eternal darkness at 3000 meters depth, illuminating drifting marine snow particles like a cosmic nebula in deep space
Close-up of a mysterious deep-sea anglerfish hovering motionless in the dark current, its bioluminescent esca lure glowing with hypnotic blue-green light, intricate translucent fins
Camera tilts downward revealing a dramatic volcanic rift valley on the ocean floor, faint molten orange glow emanating from fissures in the black basalt rock, clouds of mineral-rich water
Towering hydrothermal black smoker chimneys erupting superheated mineral clouds on the abyssal plain, surrounded by dense colonies of crimson-plumed giant tube worms and white vent shrimp
The camera glides past the hydrothermal vents and descends along a sheer vertical cliff face into the Mariana Hadal Trench at 10000 meters, ancient stratified rock walls illuminated by rover lights
Reaching the tranquil seabed of the hadal trench, revealing an otherworldly garden of glowing bioluminescent glass sponges and delicate sea lilies swaying gently in the deep current
Close tracking shot of a ghostly translucent hadal snailfish swimming gracefully inches above the fine abyssal sediment, its internal organs softly glowing under the documentary lighting
Slow awe-inspiring push-in shot toward a colossal natural basalt stone arch on the trench floor covered in pulsing bioluminescent deep-sea corals emitting soft emerald and azure light
Passing through the underwater stone arch as thousands of glowing deep-sea medusa jellyfish and siphonophores rise together in a spiraling bioluminescent vortex
Majestic low-angle upward shot as the submersible ascends slowly through the swirling galaxy of bioluminescent marine life, golden spotlights blending with natural cyan ocean glow
Final slow cinematic pull-back into the vast silent blue abyss, distant bioluminescent organisms twinkling like stars in the eternal ocean depths, peaceful documentary finale
